description.la: De institutione novitiorum: de disciplina interioris hominis et exterioris vitae.
description.en-US: Hugh’s manual for novices: conduct, discipline of mind and body, reading, and the way into religious life. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 176, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: O manual de Hugo para noviços: comportamento, disciplina do espírito e do corpo, leitura e o caminho da vida religiosa.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 176 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text HuDeSVi.DeInNo, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
